# Sprawl AI Directives

This project uses the Atomic Agentic Fabric (Sprawl). 
Your behavior and knowledge base are defined in the `.agents/` directory.

**MANDATORY INSTRUCTIONS:**
1. Before taking any action, you MUST read `.agents/rules/global.md` to understand your Persona and project constraints.
2. When the user asks you to execute a workflow, check `.agents/workflows/` for the exact step-by-step procedure.
3. If the user mentions a specific skill or capability, check `.agents/skills/` for the relevant documentation.

Do NOT deviate from the Sprawl conventions defined in `.agents/`.
